note: Round 5: the event sounds of the game, made from what the owner accepted in round 4 (assets/audio/rounds/round4-ratings.json). In round 4 every generated hull and gear candidate fitted, from either model. For the thruster the verdict followed the prompt (the valve prompt fitted, the air-cannon prompt was 'close': "Grundidee passt, es muss aber doller, knalliger klingen. Aktuell klingt es eher 'hauchig'"). For the shield it followed the model (Stable Audio fitted, MOSS was 'close': "etwas zu bass-lastig. ich würde ein minimales knistern/wummern mit einbauen"). So this file asks for the strengths and variants that the library needs beside the accepted candidates, answers his two notes, and tries two events he has rejected since round 1 (fold jump and fold exit: "Sollte energetisch, fauchend, rauschend klingen, nicht wie ein dumpfer schlag"). 'proven' says whether a family rests on a prompt he accepted; the others are first tries. Prompts describe a real sound a microphone could record, as in prompts.json. Fields per family: 'seconds' asked from the model, 'maxS' the longest cut, 'oneEvent' whether a second event is a fault, 'lufs' the level of every candidate on the page (one-channel measure, as in round 4), 'picks' the sources of the slots on the page in order, 'minAbove60Hz' (optional) the smallest share of energy above 60 Hz a candidate needs to be picked, 'fromRound4' (optional) the unheard kept candidates of a round-4 prompt that join this family's pool without being made again.
